title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with slight hiss but generally good clarity, capturing a standout early‑70s set highlighted by “Schoolgirl,” “New Speedway Boogie,” and a fiery acoustic‑electric flow.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its vibrant energy, memorable jams (especially the acoustic‑electric transitions and the powerful renditions of Schoolgirl, New Speedway Boogie, and the China Cat > Rider sequence) and a solid setlist.  While most listeners find the soundboard source clear enough despite some hiss and occasional bass dropouts, a few note tuning problems and cuts that mar portions of the performance.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are highly positive (5‑star) praising both the music and recording, but several reviewers point out hiss, cuts, bass loss, and tuning issues that lower the overall average to about 3.8 / 5.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear with a slight hiss; occasional dropouts and bass disappearance noted, plus some tuning problems that affect certain tracks (e.g., China Cat).

show_quality.setlist_flow: A well‑balanced acoustic then electric split that many reviewers liken to classic early‑70s Dead shows; the third set is repeatedly described as “out of this world.”

band_member_comments.Jerry: Ripping on his Sunburst Strat, even trying pedal steel during the acoustic portion; occasional vocal off‑key noted and a monitor comment about Bill’s equipment.
